feet_e029._about: E029's foot-slip table as the paper showed it up to v0.10, frozen here (paper/collect.py read it from work/<name>/foot_audit.json, blender/foot_audit.py before metric v2, run 2026-09-25). Slip is the worse foot's contact speed divided by max(manifest speed, 1 m/s): understated below 1 m/s, so entries below 1 m/s were left out. Superseded by the v2 audit (true ground speed) in research/data/e130_planting.json.

aberration_controls.check: sink: floor every frame, lowest -3 cm
pop: popping at the popped frame only
bend: a fast smooth bend is not popping

unimate._about: E129: UniMate moves on Cadet's own skeleton (tools/unimate_moves.py; the bow from the Studio's Moves from words panel). Aberrations from work/cadet/qa/aberrations.json (DQS, every frame), the build of 2026-10-02; foot slip from blender/foot_audit.py (worse foot, m/s): before = the moves as first generated, planting switched off (2026-09-30), after = with the toe bone recovered and every vertex of the shoe planted (E130, 2026-10-02). Times measured 2026-09-30 on this Mac (M5, 24 GB).

moves.salute: An object stands at attention and salutes with its right hand raised to its forehead.
moves.ready: An object drops into a ready combat stance with both fists raised and looks left and right.
moves.fist_pump: An object pumps its right fist in the air in celebration.
moves.look_around: An object looks to the left and then to the right.

planting._about: E130: which surface of the shoe is planted. Roster: 13 characters x 9 gaits, blender/foot_audit.py metric v2 (slip of the worse foot as a share of the true ground speed), each build complete from the animate stage. before = a rigid copy of the sole (vertices within 3 cm of the floor, at most 160) carried on the ankle bone (2026-10-01 backups); thinned = the whole shoe below the ankle, posed by its own skin weights (DQS), thinned to 400 points (2026-10-01); after = every vertex of it (2026-10-02). Cadet (built after the first run) is reported on his own. variants = retargeting alone on the cases that regressed, the rest of the pipeline not run.

quality._about: v0.12's rebuild of the roster on the new defaults (TRELLIS.2 at 1M faces, the generated surface filtered, debris dropped, AO-shaded hands, one skin tone, the albedo range, the modelled pose as the rest), audited by tools/model_quality.py (E132) on the shipped low-poly and albedo before (the v0.11 build) and after; medians over the characters done. Professional baselines: Blender Studio's Human Base Meshes (CC0) and Ellie from Sprite Fright (CC-BY), shape only. E137: Cadet with the T baked into the rest pose and with the modelled pose kept, aberration audit over every clip.

faces._about: E140's benchmark set - two characters per style per gender - rebuilt on v0.13's face-in-parts defaults. Face scores from the front render in soft light against the picture: NME of DWPose's 68 points after one similarity (by eye spacing), DWPose's median confidence, and per-part likeness (cosine of DINOv3 ViT-L/16 features of the render laid onto the picture). Before is the v0.12 build (Mara's: v0.12 with the head's texels at 2.5x); shape, aberration and foot audits beside v0.12's.

e134._about: E134 roster trial, 2026-10-03: the texture stage's new steps (Hunyuan3D-Paint 2.1 side and back views fitted onto our cameras, the front delit by Hunyuan's delighting model (not on anime), each garment's colour matched to the front, the albedo range) on each character's shipped v0.11 mesh, against its shipped texture. Texture measures from tools/model_quality.py (E132) on the same mesh; 'eye' is the verdict from four unlit albedo renders side by side (charforge_notes/polish/e134/trial/*_sheet.png). Hunyuan's views are generated at 256 px (the port's 'safe' preset on 24 GB) and super-resolved to 1024.

e133._about: E133 alone, 2026-10-03: each v0.11 build's texture re-projected with the front from the reference delit by Hunyuan3D's delighting model (applied as a smoothed lightness ratio), the side and back from the default sources, then the albedo range; 'delit' keeps the model's overall level, 'level' divides the ratio by its median inside the figure (the picture's level kept). Measures from tools/model_quality.py (E132): front_back_de (CIEDE2000, same garment), light_r2, seam_de p50. Renders: charforge_notes/polish/e133/.
